mapper.sql: av.id, av.agent_definition_id, av.version_number, av.status, av.connection_id, av.model_profile_id, av.prompt_version_id, av.configuration_json, av.published_at, av.created_at, av.updated_at, pv.content AS prompt_content, pv.variables_json AS prompt_variables_json, pv.version_number AS prompt_version_number, ac.name AS connection_name, mp.model_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_version av LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM agent_version av LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM agent_version av LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.agent_definition_id = #{agentDefinitionId} AND av.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY av.version_number DESC, av.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM agent_version av JOIN agent_definition ad ON ad.id = av.agent_definition_id LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ad.status = 'ACTIVE' AND UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(av.configuration_json, '$.moduleType'))) = UPPER(#{moduleType}) AND (ad.workspace_id IS NULL OR ad.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) ORDER BY ad.workspace_id IS NULL, ad.id, av.version_number DESC, av.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM agent_version av JOIN agent_definition ad ON ad.id = av.agent_definition_id LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ad.status = 'ACTIVE' AND UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(av.configuration_json, '$.moduleType'))) = UPPER(#{moduleType}) AND (ad.workspace_id IS NULL OR ad.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) ORDER BY ad.workspace_id IS NULL, ad.id, av.version_number DESC, av.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM agent_version av LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.agent_definition_id = #{agentDefinitionId} AND av.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY av.version_number DESC, av.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM agent_version av LEFT JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.id = av.prompt_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection ac ON ac.id = av.connection_id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.id = av.model_profile_id WHERE av.agent_definition_id = #{agentDefinitionId} ORDER BY av.version_number DESC, av.id DESC
SELECT id FROM ai_connection WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM model_profile WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1
SELECT connection_id FROM model_profile WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1
SELECT pt.id FROM prompt_template pt JOIN prompt_version pv ON pv.template_id = pt.id WHERE pv.id = #{id}
